wording.why: Players will guess Veigar's Event Horizon (a cage that stuns) and Aurora's R (slows on the edge); the excludes don't name them.
wording.suggestion: Add to the excludes: 'cages that stun or slow rather than block (Veigar's Event Horizon, Aurora's ultimate)'.

fun.why: Only 8 answers; Anivia, Jarvan IV and Taliyah are easy, but Yorick, Ornn and Camille are real finds.

champion:Taliyah.why: Weaver's Wall is a famous wall.

champion:Trundle.why: Pillar of Ice is well known.

champion:Azir.why: Emperor's Divide is known to mid players, not first.

champion:Yorick.why: Dark Procession's ring is easily forgotten as a wall.

champion:Ornn.why: Volcanic Rupture's pillar is often forgotten.

champion:Camille.why: Hextech Ultimatum is an arena, rarely thought of as a wall.

gemCandidates.why: 'Oh of course!': Dark Procession is a ring of spirits enemies can't walk through. About 0.12 now the Rule no longer names him.
His Q pillar is terrain he then smashes enemies into. About 0.15.
Her ult arena is inescapable for the target; about 0.1.
